meta.scope: Federal key dates + 51 jurisdictions (50 states + DC) minimum-wage & state-income-tax baseline.
meta.ymyl: All figures sourced from authoritative public data (DOL, IRS, state DOR). State-specific local items (city wage, city income tax, county property tax) arrive in later builds.
sources: U.S. DOL Wage & Hour Division — Minimum Wages for Tipped Employees (table 2026-07-01, retrieved 2026-08-09)
Tax Foundation — State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026 (retrieved 2026-08-09)

federalDates.title: Q3 2026 estimated tax due
federalDates.note: Third-quarter estimated federal tax payment (Form 1040-ES) for 2026.
federalDates.penaltyNote: IRS late-payment penalty is 0.5% of unpaid tax per month (up to 25%). Paying on time avoids it.

federalDates.title: SEP IRA & extended 2025 return due
federalDates.note: Final deadline for SEP IRA contributions (for extended 2025 returns) and Oct-15 extended 2025 federal returns.
federalDates.penaltyNote: Missed extended deadlines can trigger failure-to-file penalties (5% per month, up to 25%).

federalDates.title: ACA open enrollment begins
federalDates.note: Healthcare.gov open enrollment for 2027 coverage typically starts Nov 1.

federalDates.title: Q4 2026 estimated tax due
federalDates.note: Final 2026 estimated tax payment (also covers any remaining Q4).
federalDates.penaltyNote: IRS late-payment penalty is 0.5% of unpaid tax per month (up to 25%).

federalDates.title: W-2 / 1099 forms sent by employers
federalDates.note: Employers must furnish W-2 and most 1099 forms by Jan 31.

federalDates.title: ACA open enrollment ends
federalDates.note: Open enrollment for 2027 coverage typically ends mid-January.

federalDates.title: Tax Day (2026 federal return)
federalDates.note: Federal income tax filing deadline for most taxpayers. Most states align with this date; a few differ — verify your state DOR.
federalDates.penaltyNote: IRS failure-to-file is 5% of unpaid tax per month (up to 25%); pay what you can by Apr 15 to limit penalties.

federalDates.title: FAFSA deadline (federal)
federalDates.note: Federal FAFSA deadline for the 2026-27 award year.

federalDates.title: Order your free credit report
federalDates.note: You can pull a free report weekly from annualcreditreport.gov — stagger through the year.
